description: romgi-bio (github.com/bi0shacker001/romgi) as a droidtop flutter_embed plugin -- search the game index and download into droidtop's own library folders; romgi-bio's own screen adds BIOS and system files, PS3 licences and optional live Prowlarr and Macintosh Garden search. Unofficial (gamegrab-sources).

permissions.reason: Downloads the game index and the BIOS file list, and from romgi-bio's own screen looks up game details, BIOS files on the Internet Archive and your debrid account
Games you choose to download are placed in the matching game folder
